//: deptrac lives here, in its own composer project, and NOT in backend/composer.json.
It was installed as a --dev dependency first, and that changed the published API
contract. deptrac requires phpstan/phpdoc-parser, which arrives with
phpdocumentor/type-resolver; between them they satisfy the constructor of Symfony
PropertyInfo's PhpStanExtractor, which the framework registers automatically when
the classes are present. API Platform then began emitting class docblocks as
OpenAPI `description` values, and OpenApiContractTest went red on a docblock that
explains why Hydra is disabled -- an API-3 assertion broken by a static analyser.
Measured both ways: `composer remove --dev deptrac/deptrac` restored the spec byte
for byte, on an otherwise unchanged tree.
The hazard is bigger than the one assertion. `require-dev` is absent in production,
so the OpenAPI document the developer reads and the one the deployment serves would
have differed, and nothing would have said so. A separate project keeps the
application's autoloader free of the analyser's dependencies, which is the property
Run it with `make deptrac`, or from backend/ as
`php tools/deptrac/vendor/bin/deptrac analyse`. DeptracRulesetTest drives the same
binary, so a missing install is a failing test rather than a skipped check.
